item.tib: zhi khro rdzu 'phrul dra ba 'jig byed gshin rje nag po gshed dmar khro bcu srung zlog rtsa ba'i 'khor lo
item.coloph: ces 'jigs ('jig) byed gshin rje gshed kyi khro bcu rtsa ba'i srung zlog 'khor lo 'di ni/ mtshungs med gsang sngags grags pa rin po ches 'di lta bu zhig dgos shig gi bka' mchid nye bar phab pa dang / rang snang rtog pa'i nying 'khrul la'ang khro bcu spyi bsdus kyi 'khor lo blo yis lcogs tsam bkod chog tshul byung phyir/ shar rgyal mo rong gi nub phyogs dbang gi zhing khams bstan 'dzin rgyal po'i pho brang bsam 'grub seng rdzong gi yang thog ngo mtshar rab gsal du/ thos chung kun grol grags pas me sbral hor zla dang po'i dkar phyogs su brtsams pa 'dis kyang 'chi med yum sras gshen gyi bstan pa rin po che'i rgyan du gyur cig/
